payload.rationale: This document is a sprint retro from Tanya (2026-07-29) that closely mirrors the prior Sprint 4 retro (2026-03-22) — same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded the prior retro sample, the Zephyr position, the velocity observation, and the thesis-proven positions so the passes can recognize this as a continuation or duplicate of Sprint 4. I also expanded the AntiSlack positioning narrative and its children (product category, anti-pattern) because the async decision widget is the productization of that thesis, and the two style observations (direct quotes, metric anchoring) because this document uses both conventions. I deliberately did NOT expand Position_PricingTwelveDollars since pricing is not mentioned in this document.
